Definition: Elon, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Elon is the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelites. In Genesis 26:34, the text says "and Bashemath the daughter of Elon the Hittite." It is a place, not a person, so there is no People profile for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elon matters because God's story happened in real places, and Elon is one of them.
